confirm.accessRequest.rejectDesc: They get a short email saying the request was not approved.
confirm.accessRequest.rejectUnconfirmedD: The requester never confirmed the email, so no email is sent.
confirm.admin.deactivateDesc: They can no longer open the console.
confirm.admin.markDesc: It becomes a local emergency-access account: never bound to the identity provider, allowed to use its password when the IdP is required, and every sign-in alerts all administrators.
confirm.admin.resetDesc: They are signed out of the console and must set up two-step verification again the next time they open it. Use this when they lose their authenticator. Their password is their account's and is reset from the sign-in page.
confirm.admin.testDesc: Records its last sign-in as its periodic test. Confirm only if that sign-in was a planned test, not an emergency or an unexpected use.
confirm.admin.unbindDesc: They are signed out of the console. Their next identity-provider sign-in binds them again by verified email.
confirm.admin.unbindTitle: Remove the identity provider binding of {email}?
confirm.admin.unmarkDesc: It becomes a normal administrator: it can be bound to the identity provider and is subject to "require IdP".
confirm.apiKey.deleteDesc: Every client using this key loses access at once, and the key leaves the list. This cannot be undone.
confirm.apiKey.revokeDesc: Every client using this key stops working at once. A revoked key cannot be re-enabled.
confirm.assetAccess.revokeDesc: They no longer see this asset unless one of their groups holds it. You can grant access again later.
confirm.assetAccess.revokeTitle: Revoke the access of {name} to this asset?
confirm.assetGroup.bulkDeleteDesc: The groups are deleted for good and their assets leave them; scans and rules that target these groups no longer cover them. The assets themselves are kept.
confirm.assetGroup.deleteDesc: The group is deleted for good and its assets leave it; scans and rules that target the group no longer cover them. The assets themselves are kept.
confirm.assetGroup.removeAssetDesc: The asset leaves the group, so scans and rules that target the group no longer cover it. The asset itself is not deleted.
confirm.assetGroup.removeAssetsDesc: The selected assets leave the group, so scans and rules that target the group no longer cover them. The assets themselves are not deleted.
confirm.assetOwner.removeDesc: They are no longer listed or notified as an owner. You can add them again later.
confirm.assetOwner.removeOwnerRef: This owner was matched from the asset owner reference, so the owner reference is cleared too.
confirm.assetOwner.removeTitle: Remove {name} as an owner of this asset?
confirm.assetRelationship.removeDesc: Only the link between them is removed; both assets stay. This cannot be undone.
confirm.assignmentRule.deleteDesc: New findings are no longer routed by it. Findings it already assigned keep their owner. This cannot be undone.
confirm.attackerProfile.deleteDesc: It is removed from every cycle that uses it. This cannot be undone.
confirm.auditChain.rebaselineCheck: The server checks the chain again and refuses if anything is unexplained or the chain changed since this review. The action is recorded in the organization audit log and the platform audit log.
confirm.auditChain.rebaselineDesc: This re-signs all {total} entries of the audit chain from the current audit log. The {explained} explained breaks will verify afterwards, and so would any edit made before now: it is irreversible.
confirm.automation.activateDesc: Its triggers start running it automatically, and its actions (for example notifications) run each time it starts. You can deactivate it at any time.
confirm.automation.deleteDesc: The workflow and its steps are deleted and its triggers stop starting it. This cannot be undone.
confirm.automation.runDesc: The workflow starts one run now and carries out its actions, which can notify people or change other systems. A run cannot be recalled, and actions it has already taken stay.
confirm.businessService.deleteDesc: Its asset links are removed, so those assets no longer take business context from it. The assets themselves stay. This cannot be undone.
confirm.businessUnit.deleteChildren: Its sub-units are kept and become top-level units.
confirm.businessUnit.deleteDesc: Its asset links are removed, so those assets no longer take business context from it. The assets themselves stay. This cannot be undone.
confirm.campaignMember.removeDesc: They lose access to this campaign. Findings they created or are assigned to stay; you may need to reassign them.
confirm.capability.forceLabel: I understand: the tools and sensors above lose this capability
confirm.capability.unused: This capability is not used by any tool or sensor.
confirm.ciPipeline.retireDesc: Findings that only this pipeline reported and nothing else has seen since close as "source retired". Findings another source still sees are not touched. Each closed finding can be reopened, and the next run of the pipeline brings it back.
confirm.ciTrust.deleteDesc: Pipelines it admits can no longer send results. Tokens already issued expire within 15 minutes. The repository scope entries it added are removed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.comment.deleteDesc: The comment is permanently deleted for everyone. This cannot be undone.
confirm.credential.deleteDesc: Template sources that use it can no longer authenticate. The secret cannot be recovered. This cannot be undone.
confirm.crownJewel.removeDesc: Its crown-jewel tracking and protection requirements are removed. The asset itself stays, and you can designate it again later.
confirm.dashboard.deleteDesc: The dashboard and its widget layout are deleted for everyone who can see it. Your data is not affected. This cannot be undone.
confirm.dashboard.deleteDescPersonal: Your dashboard and its layout are deleted. Copies you shared and your data are not affected. This cannot be undone.
confirm.dedup.mergeDesc: {names} are removed from the inventory and their findings move to {keep}. The merge cannot be reversed from the console.
confirm.discardCloseDesc: You have changes that are not saved. Closing now discards them.
confirm.discardLeaveDesc: You have changes that are not saved. Leaving now discards them.
confirm.domainPolicy.discoverable: People who sign up with an address on {domain} will see this organization.
confirm.domainPolicy.joinApproval: Anyone with an address on {domain} can ask to join, as {role}.
confirm.domainPolicy.joinAuto: Anyone with an address on {domain} joins at once, as {role}.
confirm.domainPolicy.note: You will be asked to verify it's you. You can tighten the rules again at any time.
confirm.domainPolicy.ssoOff: Accounts on {domain} can sign in without SSO again.
confirm.domainPolicy.title: Loosen the sign-up rules for {domain}?
confirm.domainPolicy.workspacesOn: People on {domain} can create their own organizations again.
confirm.domainProof.removeDesc: Entries under it stop showing as verified. Shared sensors and intrusive checks then refuse names under it.
confirm.evidence.deleteDesc: The file is permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.evidenceNote.deleteDesc: The note is permanently removed from the finding. This cannot be undone.
confirm.exposure.bulkResolveDesc: The selected exposures are marked resolved and leave the active list. Reactivate one from its row if it is still present.
confirm.finding.bulkResolveDesc: The selected findings are closed as resolved and leave the open work queues and SLA tracking.
confirm.finding.deleteDesc: The finding is permanently deleted with its comments, activity and evidence. This cannot be undone.
confirm.findingApproval.approveDesc: The finding moves to the requested status at once.
confirm.findingApproval.approveDescMore: Your approval is recorded. The finding moves to the requested status once {count} more approval(s) are in.
confirm.findingApproval.cancelDesc: The request is withdrawn and the finding keeps its current status. This cannot be undone; ask again if needed.
confirm.findingTemplate.bulkDeleteDesc: These templates are removed for good and cannot be restored. Built-in templates in the selection are kept. Findings created from them are not changed.
confirm.findingTemplate.deleteDesc: It is removed for good and cannot be restored. Findings created from it are not changed.
confirm.gateOverride.revokeDesc: The commit is checked against the gate again from its next pipeline run, and fails it if its findings still do. A revoked override cannot be restored; create a new one if needed.
confirm.gatePolicy.deleteDesc: Pipelines in this scope fall back to the organization policy from their next run. This cannot be undone.
confirm.idp.removeDesc: People can no longer sign in to this organization with it. Make sure they have another way to sign in first. Its stored settings are deleted; you can configure it again from scratch.
confirm.ioc.deleteDesc: It is deactivated and stops matching. Its match history is kept for the audit trail.
confirm.joinRequest.desc: {email} becomes a member of this organization now, as {role}, and can see what that role allows. You can change the role or remove them later.
confirm.joinRequest.title: Let {name} join?
confirm.letter.revokeDesc: Scope entries that name this letter stop authorizing active scans at once. A revoked letter cannot be reinstated; upload a new letter instead.
confirm.linkedAsset.unlinkDesc: The asset no longer takes its business context (and criticality) from {target}. The asset itself is not changed, and you can link it again later.
confirm.member.cancelInviteDesc: The link in the invitation email stops working. You can invite this address again later.
confirm.member.disableDesc: They lose access at once: sessions end, API keys are suspended, and the scans, report schedules and workflows they own are paused. Their access groups, grants and ownership are kept, so you can re-enable them later. To end access for good, offboard them instead.
confirm.member.eraseDesc: Their name and email are replaced with an anonymous label everywhere, and their credentials are cleared. Findings, comments and audit history stay, attributed to the anonymous label. You will be asked to verify it's you.
confirm.member.grantNote: The change applies at once and is recorded in the audit log. You can remove the access again later.
confirm.member.grantRole: Role in the organization: {from} to {to}. They can do everything that role allows, in every project they can reach.
confirm.member.reenableDesc: They can sign in again and use what their roles allow. Their schedules and scans resume.
confirm.member.resetMfaDesc: They are signed out everywhere and can sign in with their password alone until they set up two-factor authentication again (required at their next sign-in if this organization requires it). Use this only after confirming their identity. They are notified by email, and the reset is recorded in the audit log.
confirm.modules.disableDesc: They disappear from the menu and their pages stop opening for every member of this organization. Their data is kept, and turning them on again brings it back.
confirm.modules.resetDesc: Every module you turned on or off by hand goes back to the default: every module available to this organization is on again. Your changes cannot be restored.
confirm.notificationChannel.deleteDesc: Notifications stop going to this channel at once, and rules that send to it lose this destination. This cannot be undone.
confirm.org.deleteDesc: The organization is closed for every member now and deleted with all of its data after 14 days: assets, findings, scans, members, roles, settings and its audit log. An owner can cancel the deletion from the sign-in page until then. Member accounts are kept.
confirm.orgTrust.apiKeys: People from {org} can create API keys here.
confirm.orgTrust.endIncomingDesc: Your people are disabled in {org} at once. Nothing is deleted.
confirm.orgTrust.endOutgoingDesc: Members from {org} are disabled here at once. Nothing is deleted: an owner can enable them again.
confirm.orgTrust.homeSso: People from {org} sign in with their own organization's SSO, so {org} controls how they authenticate here.
confirm.orgTrust.maxRole: People from {org} can now be members, not only viewers.
confirm.orgTrust.mfaOff: People from {org} no longer need to show they used MFA.
confirm.orgTrust.weakerNote: You will be asked to verify it's you. You can tighten the trust again at any time.
confirm.outbox.deleteDesc: The entry leaves the outbox and is not sent or retried. This cannot be undone.
confirm.pentestCampaign.deleteDesc: The campaign and all of its findings are deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.pentestFinding.deleteDesc: The finding is permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.pentestReport.bulkDeleteDesc: The selected report files are permanently deleted. Findings are not affected. This cannot be undone.
confirm.pentestReport.deleteDesc: The report file is permanently deleted. Findings are not affected. This cannot be undone.
confirm.platformIdp.removeDesc: Administrators sign in with their password and the console code again. Their IdP bindings are kept for the same issuer.
confirm.platformIdp.requireDesc: Administrators who are not break-glass accounts can no longer use their password for the console, and those in the console with a password are signed out now (you too, if you signed in with a password).
confirm.platformIdp.requireOffDesc: Administrators can use their password and the console code again, so a stolen password is enough to reach the sign-in step. The identity provider stays configured and administrators can still use it.
confirm.priorityRule.activateDesc: Findings that match it are reprioritized across the organization. You can turn it off again at any time.
confirm.priorityRule.deleteDesc: Findings it matched are no longer prioritized by it; the other rules still apply. This cannot be undone.
confirm.program.endDesc: Its scope entries stop authorizing scans at once and the program can no longer be changed or reactivated. Findings and history stay.
confirm.program.suspendDesc: Its scope entries stop authorizing scans until someone reactivates it and accepts the program terms again.
confirm.reportSchedule.deleteDesc: It stops sending at once. Reports already sent are not affected. This cannot be undone.
confirm.reportSchedule.resumeDesc: It emails its report to {count} recipients at each scheduled time, starting with the next one. You can pause it again at any time.
confirm.riskScore.recalcDesc: Every asset is queued for a new score with the saved configuration. Scores, priorities and the order of findings change for the whole organization while it runs. Findings themselves are not changed.
confirm.riskScore.recalcTitle: Recalculate the risk score of every asset?
confirm.role.deleteDesc: Members who have it lose its permissions at once, unless another role grants them. This cannot be undone.
confirm.role.demoteDesc: This changes their role in the organization. They lose what the {role} role grants at once. You can promote them again on the Members page.
confirm.role.removeMemberDesc: They lose the permissions this role grants at once, unless another role or group grants them too. You can add them back later.
confirm.role.widenFullData: It also gives them access to every asset, not only their own scope.
confirm.role.widenNote: The change is recorded in the audit log. You can narrow the role again later.
confirm.role.widenPermissions: This role gains {count} permissions. Everyone who holds it has them as soon as you save.
confirm.saml.removeDesc: People can no longer sign in through the identity provider. Make sure they have another way to sign in first. The stored certificate and settings are deleted; you can configure SAML again from scratch.
confirm.savedView.deleteDesc: The saved filters are deleted. The data they show is not affected. This cannot be undone.
confirm.savedView.deleteSharedDesc: The view is also removed for everyone in {group}. The data it shows is not affected. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scan.bulkDeleteDesc: The selected scans and their schedules are deleted. Past runs and findings stay. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scan.bulkDisableDesc: The selected scans stop running on their schedules and cannot be started until you activate them again. Their history stays.
confirm.scan.bulkPauseDesc: Their schedules turn off, so no scheduled run starts until you resume them. Their history is kept.
confirm.scan.cancelRunDesc: No new tasks start and running tasks stop at their next heartbeat. Results already received stay. A canceled run cannot be resumed; start a new run instead.
confirm.scan.deleteDesc: The scan and its schedule are deleted. Past runs and findings stay. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scan.enableDesc: The scan can run again. If it has a schedule, it starts at the next scheduled time and sends scan traffic to its targets.
confirm.scan.runNowDesc: A new run starts right away and sends scan traffic to every target of this scan. Its schedule does not change.
confirm.scanProfile.deleteDesc: It can no longer be chosen for scans. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scanZone.deleteDesc: Its ranges stop routing scans: private targets in them are not scanned until another zone holds them. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scannerIntegration.removeConnect: Syncs and coverage through this connector stop. Findings already pulled are kept. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scannerIntegration.removeDesc: Its imports stop and its settings are deleted. Findings already ingested are kept. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scannerTemplate.deleteDesc: It can no longer be chosen for scans. To only stop new scans from using it, deprecate it instead. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scannerTemplate.deprecateDesc: Deprecated templates cannot be used in new scans.
confirm.scimToken.revokeDesc: Your identity provider loses access to SCIM provisioning with this token at once. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scm.deleteDesc: Imported repositories stay, but they can no longer be synced through this connection. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scopeChange.rejectDesc: The requested change is not applied and leaves the approval queue. To make it later, it has to be requested again.
confirm.scopeEntry.removeDesc: Scans stop reaching what only this entry covers. Assets under it and their findings and history stay, flagged as out of scope. Adding it back needs approval.
confirm.scopeExclusion.removeActiveDesc: Scans may reach {pattern} again once it is removed. You may be asked to confirm your identity.
confirm.scopeRule.deleteDesc: Assets this rule assigned to the team automatically are removed from it, and the team loses access to them unless another grant covers them. This cannot be undone.
confirm.scopeRule.reconcileDesc: Every rule runs now. Assets that match are added to the team, and assets that no longer match are removed from it, with their access.
confirm.scopeRule.reconcileTitle: Reconcile the scope rules of this team?
confirm.sensor.bulkDeleteDesc: Their API keys stop working at once and they can no longer claim jobs or send results. Findings they reported stay. This cannot be undone.
confirm.sensor.deleteDesc: Its API key stops working at once and it can no longer claim jobs or send results. Findings it reported stay. This cannot be undone.
confirm.sensor.demoteDesc: The sensor goes back to passive work only (T0), with no credentials and no results without a job, from its next request.
confirm.sensor.demoteTitle: Set this sensor back to New?
confirm.sensor.disableDesc: It stops claiming new jobs until you enable it again. Its key and history are kept.
confirm.sensor.discardDesc: Your changes to this sensor have not been saved.
confirm.sensor.promoteDesc: A New sensor gets passive work only (T0), no credentials and no results without a job. Trusted lifts these caps up to its grant. Promote only a sensor you installed and whose pairing you verified. This is audited and every administrator is notified.
confirm.sensor.revokeDesc: It loses access at once and for good: its key is revoked and it cannot be re-enabled. To use the machine again, enroll a new sensor. This cannot be undone.
confirm.sensor.revokeDisableHint: For a temporary stop, disable it instead.
confirm.sensor.revokePauseHint: To pause it instead, turn off Enabled.
confirm.serviceAccount.deleteDesc: Its roles, team memberships and API keys are removed at once, and every integration using its keys stops working. This cannot be undone.
confirm.serviceAccount.deleteKeyDesc: The integration using this key loses access at once. This cannot be undone.
confirm.session.revokeDesc: That device is signed out at once and has to sign in again.
confirm.session.revokeOthersDesc: Every device except this one is signed out at once and has to sign in again.
confirm.siem.deleteDesc: Events stop being forwarded to it at once and its settings are deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.slaPolicy.deleteDesc: It does not apply to any finding (only the default policy does). This cannot be undone.
confirm.ssoChange.approveDesc: It changes who can sign in to this organization. Approve only a change you expected and whose identity provider you recognize.
confirm.ssoChange.rejectDesc: The proposed change is discarded; the current sign-in configuration stays as it is.
confirm.suppression.approveDesc: Matching findings are suppressed while this rule is active.
confirm.suppression.deleteDesc: Findings it suppressed are no longer suppressed by it. This cannot be undone.
confirm.suppression.previewCapped: More than {limit} open findings match. This approval closes {limit} of them; the rest stay open.
confirm.suppression.previewError: Could not count the open findings this rule matches. Approving still closes them.
confirm.suppression.previewLoading: Counting the open findings this rule matches…
confirm.suppression.previewNone: No open findings match this rule now. It applies to new findings as they arrive.
confirm.suppression.previewOutOfScope: {count} matching findings are on assets outside your access and are not listed.
confirm.suppression.previewSampleAria: Findings this rule matches within your access
confirm.targetMapping.activateDesc: It is used again when scans are filtered.
confirm.targetMapping.deactivateDesc: It is kept but ignored: scanners that only reach these assets through it will skip them.
confirm.targetMapping.deleteDesc: Scanners that only reach {type} assets through it will skip them. To pause it instead, deactivate it.
confirm.team.bindRoleDesc: Every member of the team gets every permission of this role at once, and so does everyone who joins later. You can remove the role again.
confirm.team.bindRoleDescCount: All {count} members of the team get every permission of this role at once, and so does everyone who joins later. You can remove the role again.
confirm.team.bindRoleTitle: Add the role {name} to the team?
confirm.team.deleteDesc: Members lose the access this team gives them, including to assets the team owns. This cannot be undone.
confirm.team.removeAssetDesc: The team and its members lose access to this asset unless another grant covers it. The asset itself stays.
confirm.team.removeAssetTitle: Remove the asset {name} from this team?
confirm.team.removeMemberDesc: They lose the access this team gives them, including to assets the team owns. You can add them again later.
confirm.team.removeRoleDesc: Members who hold it only through this team lose its permissions at once.
confirm.team.removeRoleTitle: Remove the role {name} from the team?
confirm.templateSource.deleteDesc: Every template synced from it is removed too. This cannot be undone.
confirm.threatActor.deleteDesc: It is removed from this organization catalogue. This cannot be undone.
confirm.ticketing.deleteDesc: Its settings are deleted and findings no longer sync with it. Tickets already in the tracker are not deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.tool.deleteDesc: It leaves the tool list and can no longer be chosen for scans. This cannot be undone.
confirm.verifiedDomain.removeDesc: It no longer gates SSO auto-join. You can add and verify it again later.
confirm.workflowStep.builderDeleteDesc: The step leaves the workflow you are editing, and steps that depended on it lose that dependency. Nothing changes until you save.
confirm.workflowStep.deleteDesc: The step leaves the draft and steps that depended on it lose that dependency. The published workflow is not changed until you publish.
confirm.mcpClient.unblockDesc: Every organization on this deployment can authorize this application again. Connections that were cut off are not restored; each member connects again.
confirm.mcpPolicy.dpop: Connections no longer need proof of possession, so a stolen token works anywhere.
confirm.mcpPolicy.enable: AI assistants can connect to this organization again.
confirm.mcpPolicy.keys: API keys can use the MCP server, with no person in the loop.
confirm.mcpPolicy.note: It applies to existing connections at once. You will be asked to verify it's you.
confirm.mcpPolicy.title: Give AI assistants more access?
confirm.mcpPolicy.tlp: Assistants can read content up to {tlp}.
confirm.mcpPublisher.addDesc: Every member can then connect applications published on this host. Each person still approves what an application may do. You will be asked to verify it's you, and you can remove the publisher later.
confirm.mcpClient.blockDesc: Every organization on this deployment loses the use of this application at once: its tokens stop working and it cannot be authorized again until you unblock it.
confirm.asset.archiveInsteadDescOne: It has 1 finding, so it cannot be deleted: that would erase the finding history. Archiving hides it from lists and scans and keeps its findings; you can activate it again later.
confirm.asset.archiveInsteadDesc: It has {count} findings, so it cannot be deleted: that would erase the finding history. Archiving hides it from lists and scans and keeps its findings; you can activate it again later.
confirm.asset.deleteDescIrreversible: This cannot be undone. It leaves every list and is removed from its groups, owners, relationships and scope; its name can be used again. An asset that has findings is not deleted: archive it instead, so its finding history is kept.
confirm.asset.bulkDeleteDescIrreversible: This cannot be undone. They leave every list and are removed from their groups, owners, relationships and scope. An asset that has findings is not deleted: archive it instead to keep the finding history.
confirm.asset.bulkWithFindingsOne: 1 of them has findings, so it is not deleted; you can archive it afterwards.
confirm.asset.bulkWithFindings: {count} of them have findings, so they are not deleted; you can archive them afterwards.
confirm.slaPolicy.makeDefaultDesc: New deadlines will follow this policy from now on. Open findings are re-scored right away: where this policy has tighter windows their deadlines move earlier; they are never moved later, so switching back does not restore the old deadlines.
confirm.savedView.saveCurrent: Save current filters as a view
confirm.savedView.saveDesc: Saves the current filters, sort, grouping, columns and density. A shared view shares the filters, not the results: everyone sees the findings they are allowed to see.
confirm.savedView.name: Name
confirm.scan.activateDesc: The scan starts running at each scheduled time and sends scan traffic to its targets. You can turn the schedule off again at any time.
confirm.scan.bulkActivateDesc: Their schedules turn on. Each scan starts at its scheduled time and sends scan traffic to its targets.
confirm.savedView.change.filters: {count, plural, one {# filter added} other {# filters added}}
confirm.assetGroup.bulkCriticalityTitle: Set the criticality to {value} for {count} selected?
confirm.assetGroup.bulkEnvironmentTitle: Set the environment to {value} for {count} selected?
confirm.assetGroup.bulkCriticalityDesc: The value replaces each group's current criticality and can change how its findings are prioritised. You can set it back to the old value later.
confirm.assetGroup.bulkEnvironmentDesc: The value replaces each group's current environment. You can set it back to the old value later.
confirm.assetScan.title: Scan {count} repositories now?
confirm.assetScan.descOne: The scan starts right away and runs on your scanners. Findings from earlier scans are kept.
confirm.assetScan.desc: A scan starts right away on each repository and runs on your scanners. Findings from earlier scans are kept.
confirm.suggestions.approveAllDesc: This creates {count} relationships between your assets, including suggestions on other pages and ones hidden by the search. You can remove a relationship afterwards from the asset it belongs to.
confirm.suggestions.approveSelectedDesc: This creates {count} relationships between your assets. You can remove a relationship afterwards from the asset it belongs to.
